[[Foolad F.C.|Foolad]] were the [[2013–14 Persian Gulf Cup|defending champions]]. The season featured 13 teams from the [[2013–14 Persian Gulf Cup]] and three new teams promoted from the [[2013–14 Azadegan League]]: [[Padideh F.C.|Padideh]] as champions, [[Naft Masjed Soleyman F.C.|Naft Masjed Soleyman]] and [[Paykan F.C.|Paykan]]. The league started on 1 August and ended on 15 May 2015.
